chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Rabīʿ ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sulaymān al-ʿĀmirī, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام: What do you say about a man whom I heard reviling ʿAlī عليه السلام and dissociating himself from him?
He said: Then he said to me, “By Allah, this one is lawful in blood, and a thousand of them are not equal to one man from among you. Leave him.”

key_terms.حَلَالُ الدَّمِ: deemed licit in blood, indicating loss of blood-protection in the wording of the report
key_terms.عَلِيًّا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam ʿAlī, the object of loyalty and reverence in the report

ai.seo_question: What does Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām narrate from Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام about someone who insults Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام and disavows him?
ai.summary: This hadith records a question posed to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام about a man who reviled Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام and declared dissociation from him. The response conveys severe condemnation of such hostility toward Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام and expresses a legal judgment together with an instruction to leave the man.
